# nemau_kubernetes_versions (Data Source)

The supported Kubernetes versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nemau_kubernetes_versions" "supported" {}

output "kubernetes_versions" {
  value = data.nemau_kubernetes_versions.supported.versions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `latest` (String) The last entry in the list, in the platform's own order. Pin an explicit version for a production cluster instead, because `latest` changes when new versions are added.
- `versions` (List of String) The versions a cluster can be created with or upgraded to.
